name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: UI SDK Tabs: arrow-key navigation, automatic or manual activation, controller support, a selected state that reads at 3:1, and a list that scrolls when its tabs don't fit, with edge fades and pointer-only scroll buttons.
docs: `TabsList scrollable` is `"auto"` by default: a horizontal list that overflows scrolls, fades the edges it can scroll to, and on fine pointers shows a button at each of those edges. The buttons are `aria-hidden`, out of the tab order and hidden from agents, since arrow keys, Home and End reach every tab and UI SDK scrolls the selected one into view. It reads the direction from the page, so it works under `dir="rtl"`. `scrollLabels` renames the buttons; `scrollable={false}` keeps a plain list.
